# Generated by scripts/generate_rural_capacity_values.py for farming.
# Keep these values flat: EU5 displays scripted-value rows in building
# max-level tooltips, and nested helpers create confusing extra rows.

farm_capacity = {
	# Public remaining-capacity path for map modes and new-building gates.
	# Capacity buildings subtract their levels directly from this sum.
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {

# Per-building max-level paths. Each one is the same flat capacity sum
# but omits that building's own capacity-consumption row.

farm_capacity_max_farming_village = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }

	}

		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }

		}

	add = {

	}

		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }

farm_capacity_max_farming_village_rotations = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"

		multiply = 0.08

	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }

farm_capacity_max_model_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}

farm_capacity_max_pomological_orchard = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }

		else = { value = 0 }

farm_capacity_max_horse_breeders = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"

		}

		else = { value = 0 }

farm_capacity_max_cotton_plantation = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:irrigation_systems }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:irrigation_systems)"
			multiply = 0.60
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:bund }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:bund)"

		}

			multiply = 0.60
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:aqueduct_system }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:aqueduct_system)"
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:farming_village }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:farming_village)"
		}
	}

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"

		}
	}

		limit = { has_building = building_type:fruit_orchard }

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:fruit_orchard)"
		}

		}

	if = {

			value = "location_building_level(building_type:incense_grove)"

		subtract = {

		}

		value = total_building_levels
		if = {

			subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:model_farm)"

			subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:fruit_orchard)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:pomological_orchard }
			subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:pomological_orchard)"
		}

farm_capacity_max_sugar_plantation = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"

	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {

			value = -5
		}
	}

		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}

		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a

farm_capacity_max_sugarcane_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:irrigation_systems }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:irrigation_systems)"
			multiply = 0.60
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:bund }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:bund)"
			multiply = 0.60
		}

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"

			multiply = 0.60
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:aqueduct_system }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:aqueduct_system)"
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:farming_village }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:farming_village)"

		}

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:fruit_orchard)"
		}

farm_capacity_max_tobacco_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"

	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }

			value = -5
		}
	}

		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}

		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a

	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }

		}
		else = { value = 0 }

farm_capacity_max_sericulture_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size

		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }

farm_capacity_max_vineyard_estate = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.08
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
